title: MZ I made a multiplayer plugin for RPG Maker MZ — And this is just the start!

posts.author: RootR7
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
So I’ve been working on something that a LOT of RPG Maker developers have been asking for — real time multiplayer in RPG Maker MZ. And yes, I got it to work.
What did I create?
I created a plugin with Google Firebase Realtime Database that enables players to:
View other players on the same map – live
Observe their characters walking around in real-time with fluid animations
Join & Host rooms with a simple room code system
No dedicated server for the game. No complicated backend.  Just Firebase + Rpg maker mz
Players connect, enter a room code and boom, they’re walking around the same map. The first time it works, it feels like magic.
Free Version – What You Get
I am releasing a basic free version of this plugin with the core movement sync feature so you can try it out yourself:
--
https://rootr.itch.io/i-made-a-multiplayer-plugin-for-rpg-maker-mz-and-its-just-the-beginning

Both versions are under active development. I’m shipping updates regularly and every bit of feedback influences the next version. Leave your questions and bug reports in the comments, I read them all.
Happy game dev, folks!
— Root ️
